summary: DermGPT is described as an AI-powered dermatology chatbot intended to improve clinic productivity and streamline dermatology workflows by providing cited answers from curated dermatology literature.
medicalPurpose: Intended as an assistant for dermatologists and staff to support practice management tasks and access dermatology knowledge; not a stand-alone decision maker or replacement for medical care/decision-making.
acceptableInput: User prompts and queries; underlying curated literature base. Input: natural language text; Output: natural language text (with citations), plus generated documents/letters. output: Natural-language answers and drafts for clinical/admin tasks (e.g., patient education, prior authorizations, messaging responses, study support).
